# AgentReady Local by MetalMindTech LLC

> "Humans buy verified outcomes today; agents buy trusted resources tomorrow."

AgentReady Local provides machine-readable business facts, AI-readiness audits, and evidence-backed implementations for medical spas and aesthetic practices in high-growth metro markets.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- Free Surface Scan: Scans 6 machine-readable signals in 30 seconds (`POST /api/scan`).
- Verified Audit ($297): 100-point scored report with live ChatGPT, Perplexity & Google AI evidence.
- Starter Install ($1,500): Flat-fee implementation of schema graph, service catalog, pricing model, and booking path.
- Professional Install ($3,500): Complete machine-readable overhaul including FAQ normalization, llms.txt tuning, and full evidence test suite.
- Monthly Monitor ($249 - $499/mo): Monthly citation re-tests, broken-schema alerts, and freshness tracking.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- Homepage & Surface Scanner: https://agentreadylocal-pi.vercel.app/
- Sample Audit Report: https://agentreadylocal-pi.vercel.app/sample-report
- Dynamic Client Reports: https://agentreadylocal-pi.vercel.app/report/lakeshore-skin
- Surface Scan API Endpoint: https://agentreadylocal-pi.vercel.app/api/scan
- Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base: https://agentreadylocal-pi.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Security Classification Rules

- Public Facts (Free): `llms.txt`, JSON-LD schema, service catalog, pricing, credentials.
- Booking (Controlled): `ReserveAction`, crawlable booking links, rate-limited API endpoints.
- Customer Data (Private): Encrypted, non-exposed PII.

## Organization Metadata

- Legal Entity: MetalMindTech LLC
- Brand: AgentReady Local
- Target Vertical: Medical Spas, Aesthetic Practices, Dermatology Clinics
- Operating Scope: Nationwide High-Growth Metro Markets (Miami FL, Dallas TX, Scottsdale AZ, Twin Cities MN, Los Angeles CA)
